name: Ruhea staging point
description: Synthetic stand-in feature on the real, IAU-named crater Ruhea (9.5 km). Flat outer plain north of the rim used as the start point.
geology: Flat outer plain north of the rim used as the start point.

name: Ruhea north rim crest
description: Synthetic stand-in feature on the real, IAU-named crater Ruhea (9.5 km). Raised rim exposing material from depth.
geology: Raised rim exposing material from depth.
science_purpose: Rim blocks can expose deeper strata excavated by the impact.

name: Ruhea inner wall
description: Synthetic stand-in feature on the real, IAU-named crater Ruhea (9.5 km). Inner wall slope below the rim crest.
geology: Inner wall slope below the rim crest.
science_purpose: The wall may show layering of material the impact cut through.

name: Ruhea ejecta blanket
description: Synthetic stand-in feature on the real, IAU-named crater Ruhea (9.5 km). Debris thrown out by the impact, outside the rim.
geology: Debris thrown out by the impact, outside the rim.
science_purpose: Ejecta shows what the crater excavated and how far it travelled.
